scope: iOS/iPadOS reference host: cross-compile and link for device and Simulator slices, .app bundling with iPhone/iPad device families, ad-hoc Simulator signature, portable lifecycle/viewport rule tests, ordered Latin+CJK font stack, and an identical-adapter exercise on the macOS build

environment.metric_source: xcodebuild -version, xcrun --show-sdk-version, simctl list runtimes, security find-identity

checks.name: device_cross_link
checks.detail: cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-ios linked the host against UIKit/Metal; vtool reports LC_BUILD_VERSION platform IOS minos 15.0.

checks.name: simulator_cross_link
checks.detail: cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-ios-sim linked the host; vtool reports platform IOSSIMULATOR minos 15.0; codesign --verify --deep --strict passes with an ad-hoc signature.

checks.name: bundle_declarations
checks.detail: plutil -lint OK; UIDeviceFamily [1,2]; CFBundleSupportedPlatforms iPhoneOS / iPhoneSimulator; DTSDKName iphoneos26.2 / iphonesimulator26.2; UILaunchScreen present.

checks.name: portable_rules
checks.detail: 7/7: lifecycle cycle, duplicate notifications, termination finality, background activation, iPad safe area, invalid insets, primary-contact handoff.

checks.name: adapter_exercise_phone
checks.output: ios_host=pass adapter="Apple M2" backend=Metal viewport=780x1652@2 frames=2 retired=true
checks.detail: The identical host module rendered two Metal frames for a 390x844 logical phone viewport, with the Chinese title line and 激活 Activate button using the bundled ordered font stack.

checks.name: adapter_exercise_ipad_safe_area_and_tap
checks.output: viewport physical=1668x1658 scale=2 logical=834.0x829.0 content=834.0x785.0@0.0,24.0; tap x=417.0 y=438.5 activated=true; frames=2 activations=1; frame1 active=394368 other=169672; frame2 pressed=394368
checks.detail: The safe-area insets shrank the root scene content without changing the surface extent; the mapped button centre activated and repainted the pressed color.

checks.name: simulator_runtime_launch
checks.reason: No Simulator runtime is installed on the verification host and no code-signing identity is available, so the app could not be installed or launched. scripts/verify-ios-app.sh performs install+launch automatically when a runtime exists and reports simulator_run=skipped reason=no_runtime here.

cross_platform_boundary.engine: The default engine core stays iOS-independent; the host consumes only jasper-ui-engine public modules.
cross_platform_boundary.host: ios/ is a binary crate; it links winit's UIKit backend and wgpu's Metal backend, and owns UIApplicationMain through winit's run_app.
cross_platform_boundary.input: winit Touch -> DesktopInput -> Engine::pointer, with host-side primary-contact tracking.
cross_platform_boundary.safe_area: ios/src/model.rs converts physical size, scale and insets into the logical content rectangle; the adapter currently takes insets from --insets because UIView.safeAreaInsets is not queried yet.
cross_platform_boundary.adapter_exercise: --features host-on-macos compiles the same host module for macOS; it is not an iOS runtime and covers no UIKit lifecycle delivery.

limits: Runtime launch on Simulator and on a device is not verified on this host.
No code-signing identity or provisioning profile was available; the device bundle is unsigned.
UIView.safeAreaInsets is not queried; safe-area insets are host-supplied.
No iOS accessibility bridge (the pinned AccessKit has no iOS backend).
No live software keyboard/IME composition, Pencil pressure/tilt, device-loss or thermal/power matrix.
No icons, storyboards, App Store packaging or provisioning automation.
